verdict.rationale: Vercel's own 'Postgres on Vercel' docs say serverless Postgres is provisioned through its Marketplace (Neon, Prisma Postgres, Supabase, Aurora) with credentials and environment variables injected into the project. The first-party Vercel Postgres product is discontinued, and the SQL engine and client come from third-party providers. Nothing in the evidence shows a query interface that removes connection management. missing for 10: first-party serverless SQL product, documented query-from-code SDK/driver, evidence of no connection management/pooling burden, hands-on corroboration

support.subject: As a developer, I can query a serverless SQL database directly from my code with no connection management

citations.quote: Provision and configure a Postgres database with minimal setup. Have credentials and environment variables injected into your Vercel project.
Neon is serverless Postgres built for the cloud, with autoscaling and instant branching.
